chunks: So that God punishes the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the idolater men and idolater women, but He turns to the faithful men and faithful women in forgiveness, for God is forgiving and kind.
ai.seo_question: How does God treat hypocrites versus the faithful according to this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Ahzab, this verse underscores the dual divine outcomes of the Day of Judgment, distinguishing between the punishment awaiting the hypocrites (Al-Munafiqun) and idolaters, and the mercy reserved for the sincere believers. Shia exegesis often highlights the gender-inclusive nature of this promise, affirming that spiritual status, rather than gender, determines one's ultimate fate, while concluding with the attributes of Al-Ghaffar and Al-Rahim to emphasize God's readiness to forgive those who repent.
